intro.text: Something a person can be anchored through, according to claims about a rare chain said to come from the lands of the dead.

description.text: Silvery chains are said to let whoever uses them anchor themselves through a Cognitive anomaly. What anchoring actually does is unknown, and the chains are extremely rare and command great prices.
One letter writer called such a chain priceless while seeing no use for it, since the writer was unable to leave the Rosharan system.
In the Shadesmar city of Celebrant, Kaladin saw a cultivationspren merchant offering a thin silver chain for what struck him as an absurd price.
